description: Complete overhaul of the share page rendering in backend/src/modules/share/share.routes.js to support all media types. Currently only renders first media item as an regardless of type. Need to: detect media type from post.media[].type field (enum: 'image' | 'video'), render video posts with proper
steps: 1. In the GET /p/:postId handler in backend/src/modules/share/share.routes.js, detect the type of the first media item using post.media[0].type (which is 'image' or 'video' per post.model.js mediaSchema)
2. For video posts (first media is type='video'): render a
3. For gallery posts (media.length > 1): show first media item (image or video appropriately) with an overlay indicator showing '1/N' media count badge
4. Add og:video meta tag when first media is video: <meta property='og:video' content='URL'> and <meta property='og:video:type' content='video/mp4'>

5. Add twitter:player meta tags for video: <meta name='twitter:card' content='player'> (override summary_large_image), <meta name='twitter:player' content='URL'>, <meta name='twitter:player:width'>, <meta name='twitter:player:height'>
6. Ensure og:image still works for video posts by using a poster/thumbnail URL (Cloudinary video URLs with .jpg extension or /so_0/ transform for poster frame)

7. Enhance platform detection in the inline script: detect iOS (iPhone/iPad), Android, and Desktop. Show appropriate CTAs: iOS gets 'Coming Soon to App Store' prominently, Android gets auto-redirect to Play Store after timeout, Desktop shows both store buttons without auto-redirect
8. Add deferred deep link support by passing the postId as a referrer parameter to the Play Store URL: add &referrer=utm_source%3Dshare%26utm_content%3D{postId} to the Play Store link
9. Ensure all existing URL patterns continue to work: old Cloudinary URLs, transformed URLs, non-transformed URLs, Google avatar URLs

findings: Implemented successfully. Node syntax check passes (NODE_OPTIONS='' node --check). Key implementation details: (1) Media type detection defaults to 'image' when type field is missing (backwards compat for old posts). (2) Video poster URL uses Cloudinary /so_0/ transform + .jpg extension. (3) Platform-specific CTA sections are hidden by default (display:none) and activated via JS class toggle. (4) Play Store URL includes referrer param with postId for deferred deep linking. (5) iOS CTA attempts deep link but does not auto-redirect since app is not on App Store yet. (6) Desktop shows both store buttons without auto-redirect or deep link attempt. (7) Gallery badge shows '1 / N' count overlay. (8) og:image is always present even for video posts (uses poster thumbnail).
